title: Refactor: Logging review for console.error in loopDetectionService.ts
body:
## Context
We are standardizing our logging and error handling. This file, `packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.ts`, contains logic to detect if the AI is in a repetitive loop.

## Task
Review the `console.error` call within the `catch` block of the `checkForLoopWithLLM` method. This log is triggered when the LLM call used for loop detection itself fails.

### Recommendation
Our analysis suggests this is a non-critical failure of a background, internal diagnostic. The service gracefully handles this by assuming no loop is present and continuing. The user is not affected.

We recommend migrating the `console.error` call to `debugLogger.warn`.

**Please evaluate this recommendation and course-correct as you see fit.** The goal is to ensure the log level matches the error's severity and context.

Reference PR #11803 for examples.

Parent Issue: #10761

linked_prs.title: fix(core): use debugLogger.warn for loop detection errors
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Replaced `console.error` with `debugLogger.warn` in `LoopDetectionService` to standardize logging for non-critical LLM loop check failures.

## Dive Deeper

The `checkForLoopWithLLM` method catches errors when the LLM call fails. Previously it used `console.error` in debug mode. This change downgrades it to a warning using the standardized `debugLogger`, as recommended in issue #11886, since this is a background diagnostic failure and not a critical application error.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify the code change by inspection. The change is a straightforward replacement of the logging mechanism in the error handler.
